sections.heading: Itinerary Positioning

children.text: This itinerary suits first-time visitors who want to combine old-town history, local street food, coffee culture and riverside scenery. The route follows a simple rhythm: one old district in the morning, one neighborhood in the afternoon, and a night market or riverside walk in the evening, avoiding too many cross-district transfers in a single day.

Day 1 explores Dadaocheng and the Tamsui River waterfront to understand Taipei’s earliest commercial district. Day 2 walks through Zhongshan, Shuanglian and Chifeng Street lane cafes, followed by Raohe Street Night Market in the evening. Day 3 keeps the pace light with a riverside walk, coffee, souvenir shopping and flexible departure-time adjustments.
